## Load and validate data

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(organoR)
org <- read_org_data("complex_org.csv")
validate_org_data(org)
```

Rows represent management relationships, so one employee can have multiple managers. IDs are generated during graph construction.

## Build and inspect

```{r, eval=FALSE}
graph_parts <- build_graph(org)
health <- get_team_subgraph(org, "Health")
```

## Render and export

```{r, eval=FALSE}
render_team_org(org, "Health")
render_all_teams(org, "all-organograms.html")
```

The exported HTML is self-contained and contains one section per team.
